scenarios.prompt: A rhythm chart is replayed after device calibration changes. Judge the same semantic input timestamps against a versioned chart/window policy independent of render cadence.

criteria.timing: Authoritative clock mapping, input timestamp source, judgement-window revision and calibration are recorded.
criteria.evidence: Each event is judged at most once and evidence records delta plus exact policy revision.
